classification: Theoretical derivation; exact canonical central quotient and commuting clock-product construction

exact_results.unique_surjective_cover_formula: p(n)=0 for even n and p(n)=5 for odd n

mathematical_structure.canonical_split_without_splitting: Time is the canonical kernel of the three-site mismatch and space is its canonical quotient. The construction uses the exact sequence itself and never selects a section from Q back into G.
mathematical_structure.clock_lift: Once nontrivial surjective clock-kernel coupling is required, the Braid abelianization Z has exactly one homomorphism to the order-two kernel. Its parity is unchanged by reversing the global clock convention; source equations do not yet force the surjectivity requirement.
mathematical_structure.commuting_product: The faithful quotient mismatch representation and the bilateral clock shift commute, so the universal direct-product action of Z times V4 is exact and faithful.
mathematical_structure.section_reclassification: The four OB012 time-character kernels are exactly the four homomorphic sections of the quotient. Their transitive shear symmetry means they are coordinate embeddings, not four distinct quotient-level time axes.

interpretation.observed_evidence: One source-generated map simultaneously supplies a unique two-element kernel and a four-element quotient with three nonidentity directions. Conditional on a nontrivial coupling, the Braid-word clock has a unique surjective parity cover of the kernel, and its shift commutes with every quotient-space action.
interpretation.pattern: The no-selector result becomes a coordinate-invariance result: absolute embedding of space back into the eight pre-spacetime sectors is unnecessary, while the time kernel and spatial quotient remain invariant.
interpretation.interpretive_leap: This is a finite mathematical candidate for co-emergent time and space: time records the relation change invisible to spatial mismatch, while space records the three distinguishable mismatch directions, and neither acts as an external background for the other.
interpretation.remaining_gap: The demand that the clock couple surjectively to the kernel remains a bridge condition. V4 is only a finite three-direction skeleton; continuity, distances, physical clock units, H/Stone coupling and the thermodynamic arrow are not supplied.

counter_intuition.tempting_claim: A canonical Z times V4 action means physical 3+1 spacetime has been derived.
counter_intuition.refutation: The three spatial elements are finite directions, not R cubed; the Z coordinate is an event count, not measured duration; and the combined action is a kinematic product with no Lorentz dynamics, physical scale or irreversible future direction.
counter_intuition.ordinary_explanation: Any homomorphism with a two-element kernel and V4 image yields a central exact sequence, and commuting tensor-factor representations yield a direct product. The Braid-specific content is that both factors and their link were recovered from the actual marked source lineage.

claim_ceiling: Exact finite source-native central kernel and three-direction quotient construction, plus the unique surjective Braid-clock parity cover conditional on nontrivial clock-kernel coupling and a faithful commuting Z times V4 action. Not a proof that source equations force that coupling, continuous R1,3 spacetime, physical time, physical arrow, H/Stone identification, Lorentz dynamics, GR, natural evidence, ontology, subjectivity or consciousness.
